stories.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the allowlist structure for tool routing, including explicit tool names, associated Pydantic models, and validation contracts to ensure only approved tools and schemas are executable.

stories.title: Tool Router Core Dispatch Logic
stories.description: Implement core allowlist-based dispatch logic that validates requested tools against the allowlist, enforces Pydantic schema validation, and routes execution to the correct domain service or facade.

stories.title: FastAPI Endpoint Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI entrypoint to ensure all tool calls from the LLM agent loop are processed through the allowlist and validation layer before execution.

stories.title: Unit and Validation Tests for Tool Allowlist Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit tests to verify that only allowlisted tools can be executed, invalid tools are rejected, and Pydantic validation errors are correctly handled and surfaced.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Invocation Integration
stories.description: Validate full tool invocation flow from LLM tool_use output through router validation, dispatch, domain execution, and response return, ensuring consistent behavior across all supported tools.
